package.name: autoware_core_adapi_compat
package.description:
The AD API operation-mode endpoints that autoware_core's default_adapi does not implement: six /api/operation_mode/* services and the latched OperationModeState topic that concealer's lifecycle is derived from.
Every endpoint here is meant to be retired by an upstream autoware_default_adapi OperationModeNode. Track this package's line count as a burn-down.
